caption:
Five deals that defined the week.

adidas put the Parramatta Eels in three stripes, L'Oréal signed its first football deal with PSG, and Adobe made the Australian Open its first tennis sponsorship anywhere. Uber Eats is now Real Madrid's delivery partner in Spain through June 2029, and Red Bull takes the title of MotoGP's first Adelaide street race.

Today's lead: adidas becomes @theparraeels official apparel partner on a multi-year deal covering the NRL and NRLW teams and the juniors. The new kit debuts in Round 1 2027.

Also today: Ford Australia x WNBL, Sky NZ x Australian Open, Flyte Aviation x Philadelphia 76ers, BetMGM x Connor McDavid, InterContinental x Wellington Phoenix.
